```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  # Live chunks only run when TXS_LIVE=true to keep CRAN builds offline.
  eval = identical(Sys.getenv("TXS_LIVE"), "true")
)
library(txschools)
```

`txschools` makes it straightforward to pull *public* school-performance
data published by the Texas Education Agency (TEA), beginning with the
Texas Academic Performance Reports (TAPR).

## Discover available years

```{r}
txs_list_years("tapr")
```

## Find the files for one year

```{r}
downloads <- txs_list_downloads(2024, source = "tapr")
downloads
```

`level` × `data_type` × `file_format` together identify a unique file.

## Download (or use cache)

```{r}
df <- txs_get_tapr(
  year        = 2024,
  level       = "campus",
  data_type   = "advanced",
  file_format = "csv",
  output      = "tidy"
)
df
```

Every call records source metadata as an attribute:

```{r}
attr(df, "txschools")
```

A re-call uses the cached copy without re-downloading.

## Citation

```{r}
txs_cite(df)
```

## Bulk multi-year downloads

```{r}
plan <- txs_bulk_plan(2024:2025, levels = c("campus", "district"))
plan
done <- txs_bulk_download(plan, delay = 5)
done
```
